azdoPbiAnalyzer.organization.description: Default Azure DevOps organization URL (e.g., https://dev.azure.com/yourorg)

azdoPbiAnalyzer.aiEnabled.description: Use a real AI provider for chat persona analysis. When off (or when no provider is configured), the built-in rule-based analysis is used.

enumDescriptions: Use the language models already available in VS Code (e.g. via GitHub Copilot). No API key needed.
Any OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter, Together, DeepSeek, xAI, ...
Anthropic Claude via the Messages API.
Google Gemini via the Generative Language API.
azdoPbiAnalyzer.aiProvider.description: Which AI provider backs the @azdo chat participant personas.

azdoPbiAnalyzer.aiModel.description: Model to use (e.g. gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4-5, gemini-2.5-flash, llama3.1, or copilot/gpt-4o for the VS Code provider). Leave empty for the provider default.

azdoPbiAnalyzer.aiEndpoint.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible provider (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1, http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama, or a full Azure OpenAI deployment URL). Ignored by other providers.
